record.title: Publish the offline entitlement and capability research handoff
record.intent: Leave a clear morning report and reusable research writing with a clean pushed source tree.
requirements: Report stock provenance, ordinary option before/after/process/reboot state, exact guest mutations, persistence scope, separate D result, negatives, remaining blockers and the next smallest physical action requiring authorization.

Update repository navigation and stale current-status statements using links to preserved historical evidence. Keep source free of private host mappings, unit-specific identities and acquired key material.
Write useful research or blog drafts based on established findings. Distinguish acceptance, queried policy, modeled durability and physical operation; do not publish to an external service.
Refresh private local reflection only where useful under the operator's explicit SOUL authorization. Keep it untracked and outside authored source.

Verify taskctl state, relevant report links and source disclosure boundaries. Commit and push meaningful conclusions, leave the repository clean, and make any remaining physical authorization boundary explicit.
acceptance: The morning handoff and research drafts are accurate, committed and pushed; private reflections remain local.
